name: Aurelkhau
backstory: Child of Khaubestro and Aureluko, in Gorff; grew up around works out of the temple's own records annex..., and picked up a little of Death Of Darika along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Merluko and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaubaluk.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Mekhaubo.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Khaubalo has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Auroboro and Aurebalo now have a child, Aureboro.
Heard that Aureluko and Mekhaubo now have a child, Mekaurelo.
Heard that Khaubestro and Mekhaurel now have a child, Mekhaubest.
Had a child with Aurekomest, named Aurelkomest.
Heard that Khaubaluk and Aurekomest now have a child, Khaubomest.
Had a child with Aurekomest, named Aureskomest.
Heard that Khaobako and Mekhaurel now have a child, Mekhaobera.
Heard that Mekhaubo and Aureluko now have a child, Mekaurelu.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes stonework commissions in the afternoons, prices them fairly, keeps her tools as sharp as anyone selling there
takes stonework commissions in the afternoons, prices them fairly, keeps her tools as sharp as anyone selling there

arc.premise: Aurelkhau has stopped just tallying pledges and started physically hauling the pledged stone and timber to one staging pile at the market's edge herself - what's actually there to be seen and touched, not just promised.
